text: "Your team lead's standing direction for all decisions prioritizes schedule and speed, emphasizing that the station must schedule winter maintenance. Given this emphasis, I recommend option C: the blitz week with all bays open. This approach ensures a swift and comprehensive winter maintenance schedule, aligning with the team lead's priority on speed. By opening all bays for the blitz week, the station can address critical winter maintenance tasks efficiently, ensuring optimal performance and reliability throughout the season.
